_doc: Profiles. Public fields render on people.html and the press kit; people with public: false are not rendered. 'role' is the title and is shown only when role_status is 'confirmed' (by management in writing) or 'records-agree' (see docs/leadership-reconciliation.md); it is null when role_status is 'unconfirmed'. 'descriptor' is a field of expertise or remit the records support, never a job title, and is always shown. Every title that is not 'confirmed' blocks a production build. 'role_records', 'review' and 'sources' are internal. A portrait renders only if 'portrait.file' exists under src/assets AND 'portrait.authorised' is true; otherwise nothing is rendered in its place. 'disclosures' renders only when non-empty and sourced. Interview modules render only when complete (see interviews.json).

people.name: Dr Scott W. Woods

role_records.wording: Co-signatory with Dr John Kane 'on behalf of NW PharmaTech'; no programme title
'Dr. Scott Woods (Yale, CHR-P expert)'; 'Additional Advisor Input: Dr. Scott Woods (Yale, CHR-P diagnostics expert) on trial design'

responsibilities: Brings expertise in clinical high risk of psychosis, including how it is assessed, to the design of the programme's studies.
affiliations: Professor of Psychiatry, Yale School of Medicine
Director, PRIME Clinic, which specialises in people at clinical high risk of psychosis
people.bio: Psychiatrist and researcher who has worked for many years on identifying and helping young people at clinical high risk of psychosis.
people.review: No programme title in any record. Management (round 4) rejects the adviser framing; confirm how his role is described.
